title: Grammar of the Wave: Towards Explainable Multivariate Time Series Event Detection via Neuro-Symbolic VLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2603.11479v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Time Series Event Detection (TSED) aims to localize semantically meaningful events in time series data, with critical applications in high-stakes domains. Unlike statistical anomalies, events are often defined by natural-language descriptions with internal temporal-logic structures across multiple physical channels. However, in real-world settings, dense event annotations are expensive to obtain, making purely supervised learning difficult. We introduce Language-guided TSED, a setting where a model is given textual event descriptions and must ground them to intervals in multivariate signals with little or no labeled data. To address this problem, we propose Event Logic Tree (ELT), a knowledge representation framework that converts linguistic descriptions into structured temporal logic over signal primitives. translated_title: 波的语法：基于神经符号VLM智能体迈向可解释的多变量时间序列事件检测
translated_abstract: 时间序列事件检测（TSED）旨在定位时间序列数据中具有语义意义的事件，在高风险领域具有关键应用。与统计异常不同，事件通常由具有内部时序逻辑结构的自然语言描述来定义，且这些结构跨越多个物理通道。然而，在现实场景中，密集的事件标注获取成本高昂，使得纯监督学习难以实现。我们提出了语言引导的时间序列事件检测（Language-guided TSED）这一新设定：模型被给定文本形式的事件描述，必须在极少或没有标注数据的情况下，将其接地到多变量信号中的相应时间区间上。为解决这一问题，我们提出了事件逻辑树（Event Logic Tree, ELT），这是一个知识表示框架，能够将语言描述转换为基于信号基元的结构化时序逻辑。在ELT的基础上，我们提出了SELA，一个神经符号VLM智能体框架，它从信号中迭代地接地基元……
tldr: 该论文提出了事件逻辑树（ELT）知识表示框架和神经符号VLM智能体框架SELA，使模型能够在极少或无标注数据的情况下，依据自然语言事件描述在多变量时间序列中定位语义事件，实现可解释的事件检测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Event Logic Tree (ELT) knowledge representation framework and SELA, a neuro-symbolic VLM agent framework, enabling explainable localization of semantically meaningful events in multivariate time series from natural-language descriptions with little or no labeled data.
